name: Juvederm Volux
lead: Juvéderm Volux (VYC-25L; Volux XC in the US) is a cross-linked hyaluronic acid (HA) filler from Allergan, made with Vycross technology and positioned as a firm gel for the chin and jawline. [1][2] A 2020 study describes it as designed to restore and create facial volume, and expert consensus authors describe it as a first-in-class Vycross filler for chin and lower-third remodelling. [1][2]

Published trials in chin retrusion, including a randomized study with 18-month follow-up and a study in Chinese adults, report effectiveness for chin enhancement. [1][3] A US trial registered for jawline definition enrolled 206 participants. [4] In looksmaxxing forums it is discussed as a jawline and chin option.
infobox: HA; hyaluronidase can dissolve HA fillers

paras: Volux is marketed for chin retrusion and jawline definition. An expert consensus report was published to guide clinicians new to the product on technique and to standardize procedures. [2] Reports also describe its use for chin reinforcement alongside the related VYC-20L gel. [5]

A case report describes recalcitrant sterile abscesses after Volux treatment and a therapeutic approach to them. [6] Laboratory work has tested how many commercial HA fillers, among them various products, respond to recombinant hyaluronidase. [7][8]

A prospective, single-blind, controlled study randomized subjects with chin retrusion 3:1 to immediate or delayed Volux treatment and evaluated safety and effectiveness over 18 months and after repeat treatment. [1] A study in Chinese adults reported Volux enhanced the chin and jawline by correcting retrusion. [3]
Registered trials include a Chinese phase 3 chin trial (n=150), a US jawline phase 3 trial (n=206) and a comparison with Restylane Shaype for chin augmentation (n=40). [4][9][10]

lore.intro: On looksmax.org, Volux appears in threads about jawline fillers, where users share experiences of chin treatment.

claims.claim: Volux gives results similar to Voluma for the chin but with more discomfort
claims.believers: One looksmax.org poster reported using it on the chin, said the results were no different from Voluma, and described it as more painful with about two weeks of soreness. [11]
claims.experts: No published head-to-head study of the two products was found; the published trials evaluate Volux on its own for chin and jawline. [1][3]

card.summary: Allergan's firm HA gel for chin and jawline, with published trials and little community data beyond anecdotes.
card.note: Prescription medical device; one case report describes sterile abscesses.

quick.overview:
Volux is a firm hyaluronic acid filler intended to build chin projection and jawline definition.

A controlled study followed chin treatment for 18 months and a trial in Chinese adults reported chin improvement. Forum posts are limited to individual accounts.
quick.mechanism: A cross-linked HA gel (Vycross) is injected near the chin or jaw to add volume and shape, then gradually degrades.
quick.risks: Reported risks include soreness and, in case reports, sterile abscesses. Like other HA fillers it can be dissolved with hyaluronidase. It is administered by licensed clinicians.
